links.comparator_used: Gemini 2.0 Flash given the guideline without RAG (REK+/RAG−), and Gemini 2.0 Flash without the guideline (REK−/RAG−, training knowledge alone)
links.outcome: Staging accuracy for 100 fictional pancreatic cancer cases (overall, and TNM classification)
links.effect: Overall staging accuracy 70% with REK+/RAG+ vs 38% REK+/RAG− and 35% REK−/RAG−; TNM accuracy 80% vs 55% and 50%
links.quote: The REK+/RAG+ group achieved 70% staging accuracy, outperforming REK+/RAG− (38%) and REK−/RAG− (35%).
